Nerve-Point Strike.name: Nerve-Point Strike
Nerve-Point Strike.description: The user lands a precise knee or knuckle strike on a nerve point: the outside of the thigh or the inside of the upper arm. Deals bludgeoning damage, and the struck limb goes numb: the target cannot put weight on that leg or grip with that arm until the end of their next turn. Thick armor or a hardened body blocks the effect. Stamina: brief.
